findings.title: Winter rains threaten 1,000 Gaza shelter sites, councils warn
findings.location: Gaza Strip; al-Mughraqa and al-Zahra, central Gaza
findings.affected_population_system: The Union of Gaza Strip Municipalities, following a Wednesday meeting, estimated about 1,000 displacement sites at risk of flooding, approximately 200,000 tents requiring replacement, and over 2,000 damaged buildings at risk of collapse. Damaged drainage and sewers and insufficient pumps constrain municipal response. The union requested pumps, backup generators, fuel and emergency repair materials. These are attributed risk and capacity estimates, not newly observed flood damage.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: about 200,000 tents need replacing, and more than 2,000 damaged buildings are at risk of collapse
findings.source_type: Established news outlet reporting a named municipal union assessment

bounded_discovery_context.method: Bounded date-targeted search and full Al Jazeera article; compared against all 14 authenticated same-day ledger files and prior OCHA situation report.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Distinct newly discovered municipal assessment dated November 25 with quantified site/building exposure and response-capacity constraints, not the November 24 general storm warning or the previously logged household testimony. Same-day ledger contains no matching assessment.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Exact publication hour and independent verification of municipal figures unavailable. Cannot establish article first appeared during the hour; newly discovered in this window. Do not count projected exposure as actual damage, or sum risk figures. Earlier storm damage and EU access appeal are not separately admitted.
